text: You go about so gloomily, and look at the heath as if it were somebody’s gaol instead of a nice wild place to walk in.” He looked towards her with pitying surprise. “What, do you like Egdon Heath?” he said. “I like what I was born near to; I admire its grim old face.” “Pooh, my dear. You don’t know what you like.” “I am sure I do. There’s only one thing unpleasant about Egdon.” “What’s that?” “You never take me with you when you walk there.
